title: Second Storage Space Discount — RV & Boat Storage Billing Desk Training Note
content:
**The rule.** When a customer holds two active RV & Boat Storage rentals, the rental with the lower monthly rent receives the second-space discount percentage off its rent each month, rounded half up to the cent; the higher-rent space never does. The second-space discount and a prepay discount never stack on the same month's rent — the larger of the two applies — while the autopay discount is added to whichever applies. When either rental closes, the discount stops from the next month.

The monthly credit on the lower-rent space is that space's monthly rent multiplied by the second-space discount percentage divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent. It is posted as a credit against that month's rent on the lower-rent rental.

### Questions this note answers

**Which of the two spaces gets the credit?**
The one whose monthly rent is lower. The space with the higher monthly rent never receives the second-space discount, whichever of the two was rented first.

**What if the lower-rent space is also on a prepayment?**
The second-space discount and the prepay discount are not both credited against the same month's rent. Whichever of the two is the larger amount for that month is the one credited.

**What happens to the autopay credit?**
It is not part of that comparison. Where autopay is enrolled, the autopay credit is credited in addition to whichever of the second-space or prepay discount applies.

**When does the credit end?**
When either of the two rentals closes, the discount stops from the next month.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

*Figure 1 — plain credit.* Two active rentals with monthly rents of 72.00 and 164.00, second-space percentage 10. The 72.00 space is the lower-rent space: 72.00 multiplied by 10 divided by one hundred is 7.20, credited each month. The 164.00 space receives no second-space credit.

*Figure 2 — rounding.* Lower-rent space at a monthly rent of 77.75, percentage 10: the product is 7.775, which rounds half up to 7.78.

*Figure 3 — prepayment on the same space, with autopay.* Lower-rent space at 72.00, percentage 10, prepaid for 6 months at a 5 percent prepay discount, autopay enrolled with a monthly autopay credit of 3.00. Second-space discount 7.20; prepay discount 3.60. The larger, 7.20, applies; the autopay credit of 3.00 is added to it, for total credits of 10.20 against that month's rent.

*Figure 4 — equal amounts.* Lower-rent space at 72.00, percentage 10, prepaid for 12 months at a 10 percent prepay discount, no autopay. Both discounts come to 7.20. Because the two never stack, the month's rent carries one discount of 7.20, not 14.40.
